purpose: Produce a deterministic, publication-gated follow-on research map from the qualified WP1 periodic-orbit catalogue without interpreting numerical structure as a new invariant.
evidence_boundary: A PASS verifies one-to-one ingestion of all 169 frozen catalogue candidates, exact preservation of masses and qualified planar S/U labels, deterministic evidence-quality ordering, bounded track assignment, and explicit publication gates. It does not discover an invariant, establish KAM stability, construct a normal form or invariant manifold, qualify spatial stability, infer non-meromorphic integrability, or widen the WP1 catalogue claim.

wp4_mr_v2_boundary.role: Bounds permitted targets; the map does not depend on or reproduce its theorem proof.

classification.first_nve_exception_overlay: HIGHER_VARIATIONAL_EXCEPTION when exact sigma is one of 1/3, 8/27, 2/9

quality_order.purpose: Prioritize numerically best-qualified representatives within a track, not scientific importance.
quality_order.numeric_parsing: Repository hexadecimal floats are parsed exactly as binary64 values; ordering has no tolerance.

candidate_protocol.publication_gate: No candidate output may be interpreted as an invariant before a separately named and locked candidate-specific qualification passes.

independent_validation.production: Pure-Python exact mass arithmetic and deterministic tuple ordering.
independent_validation.reference: A source-disjoint SymPy Rational implementation recomputes sigma, overlays, counts, and ordering.

adversarial_controls: Reject a missing or duplicated candidate.
Reject any changed candidate mass or S/U label.
Reject any output that uses invariant-discovery language.
Reject any output lacking a candidate-specific publication gate.
Reject a ranking that changes under input row permutation.

decision_policy.PASS: Every frozen input, one-to-one mapping, exact classification, deterministic-order, independent-reference, adversarial, publication-gate, and boundary check passes.
decision_policy.FAIL: Any changed prerequisite, missing candidate, classification disagreement, nondeterminism, overinterpretation, or gate omission fails v1 and requires a successor.
decision_policy.AUTHORIZED_CLAIM: The project has a deterministic, evidence-ranked and publication-gated work map for all 169 qualified WP1 catalogue members, partitioned into bounded local-normal-form and asymptotic-manifold tracks with exact higher-variational overlays.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_CLAIM: WP1 catalogue residuals reveal a new invariant or establish any form of integrability.

invalidation: Any changed prerequisite, classification, quality key, expected count, output schema, publication rule, control, decision rule, or frozen implementation invalidates v1.
